<p class="MsoNormal"></p><p> <b><u><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">About the Opportunity:</span></u></b></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;border:none 1pt;padding:0cm;">Role:</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> Content </span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Level:  </span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Manager</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;border:none 1pt;padding:0cm;">Reporting To:</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">  Director - Content  </span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;border:none 1pt;padding:0cm;">Location:</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> Gurugram</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b><u><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"><br /></span></u></b></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b><u><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">About the Function</span></u></b></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">With a deep understanding of Indian
consumers' travel preferences, the MMT Holidays team curates a wide array of
holiday packages for destinations across the globe.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">As a leading name in the leisure travel
space, MMT Holidays serves over 3 lakh travelers annually. Our offerings span
both domestic and international markets, covering more than 50 destinations
worldwide. With a strong focus on delivering seamless and memorable travel
experiences, we have become a trusted choice for holiday packages among Indian
travelers.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b><u><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">About the role:</span></u></b></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> MakeMyTrip’s
Holidays & Experiences Content team is looking for a content lead who can
turn content from a communication function into a growth and conversion lever.
The role will lead content strategy across Holiday Packages, Tours &
Attractions and Cruises – categories where customers need not just inspiration,
but the right information, context and confidence to make a purchase decision.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;">The
incumbent will combine strong people leadership, customer understanding,
content craft, AI-led scale and an instinct for emerging trends to build
content that helps customers discover, decide and ultimately book. This is a
role for someone who can think strategically, build and motivate a
high-performing team, challenge the status quo and get things done</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b><u><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">What will you be doing</span></u></b></p><ul><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><span style="text-indent:-18pt;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Define and
drive the overall content strategy for <b>Holiday Packages, Tours &
Attractions and Cruise</b>.</span></li><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;">Identify
customer needs, content gaps and opportunities across these businesses,
and <b style="color:#000000;font-size:10pt;text-indent:-18pt;">initiate new projects based on customer insights, market trends and
industry benchmarks.</b></li><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;">Lead a
team of writers, editors and analysts to <b style="color:#000000;font-size:10pt;text-indent:-18pt;">develop accurate, persuasive
and user-centric content </b><span style="color:#000000;font-size:10pt;text-indent:-18pt;">across the app, website, post-sales
communication and other customer touchpoints.</span></li><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b style="text-indent:-18pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Manage
content production and end-to-end project execution,</span></b><span style="text-indent:-18pt;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> ensuring high quality, timely
delivery and adherence to content guidelines across team members, agencies and
third-party stakeholders.</span></li><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b style="text-indent:-18pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Translate
complex travel products, inclusions, itineraries and experiences</span></b><span style="text-indent:-18pt;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> into clear, engaging and
customer-friendly content across short and long-form formats</span></li><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b style="text-indent:-18pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Partner
with key stakeholders</span></b><span style="text-indent:-18pt;font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> including
Category, Product, SEO, Marketing and Business Development to deliver content
requirements and support business priorities.</span></li><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;">Ensure
consistency across content in terms of <b style="color:rgb(0,0,0);font-size:10pt;text-indent:-18pt;">style, format, tone, imagery and
videos</b><span style="color:rgb(0,0,0);font-size:10pt;text-indent:-18pt;">, while maintaining factual accuracy and alignment with MakeMyTrip's
brand communication principles.</span></li><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;"><b style="text-indent:-18pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Apply
industry best practices, competitive benchmarking and customer insights</span></b><span style="text-indent:-18pt;font-size:10pt;color:rgb(0,0,0);"> to identify ideas that improve
content strategy, customer experience and funnel efficacy.</span></li><li style="line-height:normal;vertical-align:baseline;">Monitor
and analyse <b style="color:rgb(0,0,0);font-size:10pt;text-indent:-18pt;">content performance indicators and customer signals </b><span style="color:rgb(0,0,0);font-size:10pt;text-indent:-18pt;">to
identify opportunities for continuous improvement.</span><b style="color:rgb(0,0,0);font-size:10pt;text-indent:-18pt;">Explore and implement
AI-led tools and workflows to improve content quality, productivity,
scalability and operational efficiency</b></li></ul><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><b><u><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Qualifications & Experience </span></u></b><b></b></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><b><u><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">
<br />
</span></u></b></p><p></p><ul style="margin-top:0cm;" type="disc">
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Master's degree in <b>English, Mass
     Communication, Journalism or a related field.</b></span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">10+ years of experience</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> in content, editorial,
     brand, digital or related roles, with significant experience in
     customer-facing content and <b>3+ years of experience managing and
     developing teams.</b></span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Strong understanding of <b>content
     strategy, brand communication, customer journeys and digital experiences.</b></span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Demonstrated ability to connect content
     with <b>business metrics, customer behaviour and conversion.</b></span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Strong writing, editing, storytelling and
     communication skills.</span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Experience working cross-functionally
     with <b>Product, Marketing, SEO, Analytics and Business teams.</b></span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Strong working knowledge of <b>AI tools
     and emerging content technologies</b>, with a demonstrated curiosity to
     experiment, build and scale.</span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Experience in <b>travel, e-commerce,
     hospitality, consumer internet or lifestyle brands</b> is preferred.</span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Comfortable working with CMS platforms,
     content workflows, analytics and productivity tools.</span></li></ul><p style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"><br /></span><b><u><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Key
Success Factors for the Role:</span></u></b></p><ul style="margin-top:0cm;" type="disc">
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">Content that moves the funnel:</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> Measurable impact on
     discovery, engagement, decision-making and conversion.</span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">A stronger content engine:</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> Better quality, greater
     speed and significantly more scale through technology and AI.</span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">A high-performing team:</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> Strong ownership,
     capability, collaboration and talent development.</span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">A differentiated content experience:</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> Content that gives MMT
     customers a genuine advantage in discovering and choosing travel.</span><p></p></li>
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:7.5pt;line-height:normal;"><b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;">A future-ready function:</span></b><span style="font-size:10pt;color:#000000;"> Consistently experimenting
     with new formats, technologies, trends and ways of working.</span><p></p></li>
</ul><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:1rem;line-height:normal;background-size:initial;vertical-align:baseline;">























































</p><p class="MsoNormal"> </p><p></p>
